description.zh: 四人小队一间一间往下走,最深处是深渊督军(2d6 战斗、火把、药水)
description.en: A crew of four goes down room by room to the pit warlord (2d6 fights, torches, potions)

description.zh: 2d6 + 技能对难度的检定,五种技能各是一个内心的声音,恐惧和体力两条血条,同伴的恐惧和信任
description.en: 2d6 + skill against a difficulty, five skills that are inner voices, fear and stamina, companions' fear and trust

description.zh: 三人小队对一群敌人,按速度轮流出手(攻击、技能、防御、药水,中毒和眩晕)
description.en: A party of three against a band of foes, taking turns by speed (attacks, arts, guarding, potions, poison and stun)
